info.title: UniverAcademy quick Telegram registration (review fragment)
info.description: Additive and default-off (UA_TELEGRAM_REGISTER_ENABLED). For a new student inside the Telegram Mini App the server creates the Clerk account itself (external_id tg:<telegram id>, no email, no password) and returns only a short-lived one-time Clerk sign-in token. The Mini App signs in with it (ticket strategy) and then calls the existing atomic entry POST /api/v1/auth/telegram/entry with the same init_data. This operation never records a Telegram replay, never creates a cabinet and never issues an app session. It changes no existing operation in telegram-return.openapi.json.

post.summary: Prepare a new student's Clerk account from a signed Telegram launch
post.description: No bearer token: the signed init_data is the only proof and is verified (HMAC and freshness) without being consumed. Names are trimmed; each is 1-64 characters of letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes (' ‘ ’ ʻ ʼ); control characters are rejected. If the Telegram account already has a cabinet, nothing is created and already_registered is returned. At most one Clerk account exists per Telegram account; repeated or concurrent calls reuse it. Limited to 5 calls per 10 minutes per Telegram account (per server instance).

200.description: Either the student already has a cabinet (use /auth/telegram/resume) or a one-time sign-in ticket (valid 180 seconds).

409.description: IDENTITY_LINK_CONFLICT: the Clerk account for this Telegram account already belongs to another cabinet, or more than one exists.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Clerk or the database is unavailable.
